subheading: Everything you need to know about Expendesk — straight answers, no jargon.
_comment: IMPORTANT: FaqSection.tsx renders this list AND generates the FAQPage JSON-LD from it, from this one array. That is deliberate — Google requires FAQ markup to match the answer text visible on the page, and deriving both from one source makes a mismatch impossible. Never hand-write a parallel FAQ block in structured data. Adding an entry here adds it to both the page and the markup; editing an answer edits both.

faqs.question: Can Expendesk support businesses with multiple locations?
faqs.answer: Yes. Expendesk helps manage expenses across branches, departments and teams from one centralised platform.

faqs.question: Can approval workflows be customised?
faqs.answer: Yes. Expenses route by team, department, manager or spend limit, with multi-level approval chains and automatic escalation when a claim stalls.

faqs.question: Is Expendesk suitable for growing SMEs?
faqs.answer: Expendesk is built for SMEs and mid-market businesses where spreadsheets and email approvals have stopped working, but that do not need an enterprise finance suite. It scales from 5 to 500+ people without a migration.

faqs.question: Can employees track reimbursement status?
faqs.answer: Yes. Employees see the live status of every claim from submission through approval to payout, so finance is not fielding status requests.

faqs.question: Does Expendesk support policy compliance?
faqs.answer: Yes. Spend policies are enforced at the point of submission rather than discovered at audit. Out-of-policy claims are flagged immediately with a full approval trail retained.

faqs.question: How much does expense management software cost?
faqs.answer: Expendesk pricing is based on your business size, number of users and the features you need. Plans start with the essentials and scale as you grow.

faqs.question: Does Expendesk integrate with our accounting software?
faqs.answer: Yes. Expendesk connects to existing accounting systems so approved expenses and reimbursements flow through without re-keying.

faqs.question: How long does implementation take?
faqs.answer: Most teams are live within days rather than months. Setup is three steps: capture expenses, configure approval routing, then switch on reporting.
